tags.name: Custom Fields
tags.description:
Manage custom field definitions for Objectives and Key Results.

Custom fields allow workspace administrators to attach additional structured
data to OKRs — for example a "Risk level" dropdown, a "Budget" number field,
or a "Owner" user picker.

**Lifecycle**
1. Create a definition (`POST /api/v2/customField`) — this makes the field
   available in the UI for that field type.
2. Assign a value to an Objective or KR by including `customFieldValues` in
   the body of `PATCH /api/v2/okr/{id}` or `PATCH /api/v2/kr/{id}`.
3. Read values back via `GET /api/v2/okr/{id}` — the `customFieldValues` map
   in the response is keyed by field definition ID.

**Permissions** — most write operations require the `MANAGE_CUSTOM_FIELDS`
app permission (Jira admin role within the OKR app).
Read operations require OKR view access.

post.summary: Create a new custom field definition
post.description:
Creates a new custom field definition for this Jira installation.

The `type` property is the discriminator that determines which subtype of the
request body is expected:

| type         | extra fields                              |
|--------------|-------------------------------------------|
| `TEXT`       | `maxLength` (optional integer)            |
| `NUMBER`     | —                                         |
| `HYPERLINK`  | —                                         |
| `SELECT`     | `selectOptions` (required, non-empty list)|
| `MULTI_SELECT` | `selectOptions` (required, non-empty list)|
| `USER`       | `multipleUsers` (required boolean)        |
| `DATE`       | —                                         |

The `type` **cannot be changed** after creation.

Requires the `MANAGE_CUSTOM_FIELDS` app permission.

get.description:
Updates for objectives or key results, **newest first**. Omit **entityId** to return updates across all entities.

**Progress:** Prefer **`percentDone`** on objectives and key results for the latest progress — not every change produces an update row. Objective updates always have **value** null (objective progress is derived from key results). For **manual** key results, updates can carry **startValue**, **value**, and **desiredValue** to show progress over time. **Auto** key results: system updates when linked issues change may include progress values; manual text-only updates on auto KRs may omit editable progress on the returned update object. **source:** MANUAL (UI), API (public update API), or AUTO (system/linked issues).

**Pagination:** Cursor-based; **nextCursor** in the response means more pages. Absent **nextCursor**, there is no further page.

parameters.name: entityId
parameters.description: ID of a single objective or key result to return updates for. If not provided, updates for all entities will be returned, newest first.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Cursor for pagination. Use the value of nextCursor from previous response to get the next page.

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: Number of updates to return per page. Takes values from 1 to 1000. Default is 1000.

parameters.name: laterThan
parameters.description: Only return updates later than this date (open interval), in UNIX Epoch milliseconds

parameters.name: earlierThan
parameters.description: Only return updates earlier than this date (open interval), in UNIX Epoch milliseconds
